'''2007 Worlds Team Michael Richards DS Cloud City Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Cloud City: Downtown Plaza (Dark)|Cloud City: Downtown Plaza]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
